name: Jan
summary: Open-source desktop app for chatting with local models or connecting to cloud model APIs.
description: Jan is an open-source desktop application that runs open-weight models locally and can also connect to cloud providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic with the user's own API keys. It provides a chat interface, model downloads and a local API server. The project is developed in public on GitHub and also offers Jan Agent and research work. The software is free to download.

howToUse.title: Open Jan and download it
howToUse.description: Open Jan and download the desktop application. The page offers Download for Mac, the software is free to download, and it notes v0.8.7 on GitHub.

howToUse.title: Run a local model or connect a provider
howToUse.description: Download an open-weight model and run it locally in the chat interface, or connect to a cloud provider such as OpenAI or Anthropic with your own API key.

howToUse.title: Call the local API server
howToUse.description: Use the local API server when another program on the computer should call the same models.

howToUse.title: Follow Jan Agent on GitHub
howToUse.description: Follow the public development on GitHub. From the Jan site, open Jan Agent or the research work when you want the agent or the research.
